# OTTV

> OTTV (formerly IPTVMax) is an IPTV subscription with 25,000+ live channels and 120,000+ movies and TV shows. Plans run 1, 3, 6 or 12 months, priced in US dollars, with a free 24-hour trial. Orders and support run through WhatsApp.

Website: https://www.ottv.org/

## Plans

Prices are in US dollars. Each plan is a one-time payment and does not renew automatically.

- 1 month: $15.82
- 3 months: $38.30
- 6 months: $59.15
- 12 months: $88.23

Paid plans come with a 7-day money-back guarantee. A standard plan allows one stream at a time.

## Key pages

- [Pricing](https://www.ottv.org/pricing): subscription plans and prices
- [IPTV free trial](https://www.ottv.org/iptv-free-trial): how the 24-hour trial works
- [FAQ](https://www.ottv.org/faq): frequently asked questions
- [Contact](https://www.ottv.org/contact): support on WhatsApp
